title: Custom Kitchen Cabinetry
shortDescription: Handcrafted kitchen cabinets, islands, and pantry systems built to your exact specifications.
description: Our kitchen cabinetry service transforms your cooking space with fully custom, handcrafted cabinets. From shaker-style to modern flat-front, we work with every wood species and finish. Each cabinet box is made from solid wood or premium plywood, with soft-close hinges and drawer slides as standard. We handle design, fabrication, and installation end-to-end.

title: Furniture & Bedroom
shortDescription: One-of-a-kind beds, wardrobes, dining tables, and seating crafted from premium hardwoods.
description: Every piece of furniture we make is built as an heirloom — with hand-cut joinery, precision-fitted drawers, and finishes that age beautifully. We specialize in bedroom suites, dining sets, and statement living room pieces. Live-edge slabs, traditional mortise-and-tenon, or contemporary floating designs: your vision drives the brief.

title: Commercial Woodwork
shortDescription: Bars, restaurant interiors, retail fixtures, and office environments at commercial scale and quality.
description: We serve hotels, restaurants, bars, and retail brands that need woodwork built to take heavy use and look impeccable doing it. Our commercial work spans bar counters, host stands, feature walls, display shelving, and custom millwork. We coordinate directly with contractors and designers, working to commercial timelines without sacrificing craft.

title: Built-ins & Shelving
shortDescription: Libraries, media walls, home offices, and architectural millwork that become part of the room.
description: Built-ins are where woodworking and architecture meet. We design and build floor-to-ceiling libraries, entertainment walls, window seats with storage, and home office systems that look as though they were always part of the house. Every built-in is scribed to the room's walls, floors, and ceiling for a seamless fit.

title: Outdoor Structures & Decks
shortDescription: Cedar and hardwood decks, pergolas, garden furniture, and outdoor living spaces built to endure.
description: We use naturally durable species — Western red cedar, ipe, and teak — to build outdoor structures that weather beautifully. Our deck and pergola work includes integrated lighting channels, hidden fasteners, and built-in bench seating. Every outdoor piece is finished with UV-stable oils and sealed against Oregon's wet winters.
